therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Inhibition of BCR-ABL driven chronic myeloid leukemia cell proliferation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with chronic phase chronic myeloid leukemia with stable complete molecular response
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Major Molecular Response (MMR) Rate at 12 months after Dasatinib discontinuation

biomarker_changes: BCR-ABL transcript levels measured by Q-PCR
Loss of Complete Molecular Response (MR4.5) in some patients
Intermittent loss of CMR but maintained MMR in 19 participants
subgroup_findings: Event-free survival declined from 48.7% at 12 months to 43.8% at 60 months
Relapse-free survival declined from 61.9% at 6 months to 43.8% at 60 months
Progression-free survival remained high at 98.7% at 60 months
results.dose_information: Dasatinib discontinuation study - no active dosing during observation period

context.duration: Up to 82 months follow-up after discontinuation
